item.title: $106M 'mental health village' in Norwalk breaks ground: What to know
item.description: Los Angeles County officials and state leaders on Friday broke ground on a transformative mental health village in Norwalk, which will repurpose long-dormant structures on the Metropolitan State Hospital campus to address the region's urgent needs for individuals struggling with serious mental illness and homelessness.The LA County Care Community will utilize 13 acres of state land to house six renovated buildings centered around a shared courtyard. item.description: Gasoline prices across Southern California and the nation saw historic daily gains Saturday as military conflict in the Middle East throttled global energy supplies and sent crude oil past $90 a barrel.The average price for a gallon of regular gas in Los Angeles County hit $5.165 on Saturday, a 17.5-cent jump that nearly mirrored the record 19.2-cent spike seen in 2012. item.description: The Orange County Registrar of Voters announced Saturday that the filing period for three specific seats in the June primary has been extended because no eligible incumbents met the original Friday deadline.The original filing deadline of March 6 has passed, but California law triggers an extension when an incumbent does not file for re-election. item.title: US military: Is there a draft in 2026?
item.description: A measure passed by the House of Representatives in 2024 automatically registers men aged 18 to 26 for selective service.It was part of the annual National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), which sets out the U.S. government’s military and national security priorities over the next fiscal year. While it hasn’t been invoked in over half a century, it’s mandatory for all male U.S. citizens to register for the selective service, also known as the military draft, when they turn 18. item.title: Rihanna's Beverly Hills home shot at while singer was inside: TMZ reports
item.description: Rihanna's Beverly Hills home was reportedly shot at over the weekend.According to a report from TMZ, someone fired "multiple rounds" towards the singer's home on Sunday, March 8. She was believed to be home when the shots were fired, TMZ said in its report.The aforementioned TMZ report said a woman – believed to be possibly in her 30s – have since been taken into custody.It is unknown whether Rihanna's longtime partner A$AP Rocky and the couple's children were home at the time of the incident.TM
